title: Tess Herbert
info: Tess Herbert는 런던과 로스앤젤레스에서 살며 일하는 스타일리스트다. 클라이언트로는 Cartier, Gucci, Acne Studios, MoMA, Marc Jacobs, Zara, Mulberry, Barragán 등이 있다. 에디토리얼로는 American Vogue, Luncheon, T: The NYTimes Style Magazine, Dazed, Document Journal, Interview Magazine에 참여했다. Tess Herbert is a stylist living and working in London and Los Angeles. Clients include Cartier, Gucci, Acne Studios, MoMA, Marc Jacobs, Zara, Mulberry and Barragán. Editorially she has contributed to American Vogue, Luncheon, T: The NYTimes Style Magazine, Dazed, Document Journal and Interview Magazine.
